about: How each brand decides what bolt pattern a wheel comes in. This is the
other half of fitment: the vehicle table says what the truck is drilled
to, this says whether a given wheel can be had that way.
THREE STATES, and the difference matters because it decides what we are
allowed to say on the page:
made-to-order   The wheel is machined per order, so the pattern is a
choice at build time rather than a property of the SKU.
True of custom forged. We may show these for any
pattern in `patterns`, and the page says the pattern is
CONFIRMED BEFORE WE BUILD — never that it fits.
listed          The model carries a real `bolts` array in brands.js,
taken from the manufacturer's own feed. Cast wheels are
tooled per pattern and genuinely only exist in the ones
listed. These filter exactly, and are the only ones we
can filter with confidence.
unknown         We do not know. These are NOT hidden and NOT claimed —
they appear in a separate group the customer can see,
labelled as a pattern we confirm with the manufacturer.
Hiding stock we might be able to sell is as wrong as
promising stock we cannot.
WHAT IS NOT IN HERE. No brand is marked made-to-order on a guess. The six
below are the custom-forged makers whose whole product is a billet wheel
cut to the customer's spec. Several others carry forged lines that are
probably also drilled to order — Fuel Forged, Hostile's forged range, KMC
Forged — and they sit in `unknown` until someone confirms it with the rep.
That is a sales call, not a research task, and it is logged on the
checklist as 4.37.

sandPatterns.note: VW pattern — the long-standing sand rail and buggy standard.
Common on heavier rails and Class 1 cars.
Polaris-derived, on sand cars built off UTV running gear.
Lighter cars and some long-travel front ends.

american-force.source: billet forged, cut per order; carries the 10x225 F-450 pattern

fuel.confirm: Fuel Forged is cut to order; the cast Fuel Off-Road range is not. brands.js does not separate them.

hostile.confirm: Same split as Fuel — a forged range and a cast range under one brand entry.

kmc.confirm: KMC Forged is made to order; confirm the pattern range with the rep.

price-designs.confirm: Sells through a configurator, not a SKU list. The UTV models carry the pattern of the machine they are built for (X3 4x137, RZR/Pro R 4x156) and match exactly; the 17x9 truck blank is build-your-own, so it answers 'confirmed before we build' rather than claiming a drilling. Ask the rep what they will cut.
